# REST reference

Every contract API a PocketOne app with its [standard extensions](/docs/extensions/standard) answers, under `/api/_c/<contract>/`. PocketBase's own API (records, collections, auth, files, settings…) is unchanged; see the [PocketBase docs](/docs/pocketbase).

- **Auth:** an `Authorization` header with a superuser's auth token or an [API token](/docs/extensions/api-tokens). Each operation needs its token scope; a superuser's own auth token passes every scope.
- **Discovery:** `GET /api/_c/remote/v1` says who you are and lists every contract the app offers ([remote/v1](/docs/contracts/remote/v1)).
- **Input:** a JSON body for `POST`, query parameters for `GET`. **Answers** are JSON; streams are server-sent events.
- **Same as the CLI and MCP:** every operation here is also a `pocketone` command and an MCP tool, behind the same checks ([how](/docs/features/remote)).

## agent.chat/v1

[Contract page](/docs/contracts/agent.chat/v1). Answered by [Agent Chat](/docs/extensions/agent-chat) in the standard set.

| Endpoint | What it does | Token scope | Input |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/_c/agent.chat/v1/new` | Starts a chat and returns it; its id is how the app finds it again. | `chat` | `title` (string), `meta` (json) |
| `POST /api/_c/agent.chat/v1/send` | Asks the chat a question: the provider sends the system text, the chat's summary, its recent messages and the question (with Context after it) to agent/v1, saves both turns, and folds older messages into the summary when it's due. | `chat` | `id` (string), `text` (string), `system` (string), `window` (int), `summarizeEvery` (int), `context` (string), `schema` (json), `maxTokens` (int), `temperature` (json), `wait` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/agent.chat/v1/send-stream` | Is Send with the answer as it's written: agent/v1 chunks, the last one with done and the result. (stream) | `chat` | `id` (string), `text` (string), `system` (string), `window` (int), `summarizeEvery` (int), `context` (string), `schema` (json), `maxTokens` (int), `temperature` (json), `wait` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/agent.chat/v1/get` | Returns a chat. | `chat:read` | `id` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/agent.chat/v1/history` | Returns a chat's messages, oldest first: the last Limit before the message Before (all when 0 and ""). | `chat:read` | `id` (string), `limit` (int), `before` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/agent.chat/v1/update` | Sets a chat's title or meta (fields left out stay). | `chat` | `id` (string), `title` (json), `meta` (json) |
| `POST /api/_c/agent.chat/v1/list` | Returns chats, most recently updated first; Meta keeps those whose meta has each of its top-level keys with that value. | `chat:read` | `meta` (json), `limit` (int), `offset` (int) |
| `POST /api/_c/agent.chat/v1/forget` | Deletes a chat, its messages and the model's state for it. | `chat` | `id` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/agent.chat/v1/forget-where` | Deletes every chat whose meta matches (as in List), e.g. | `chat` | `meta` (json), `limit` (int), `offset` (int) |

## agent/v1

[Contract page](/docs/contracts/agent/v1). Answered by [Agent](/docs/extensions/agent/extension) in the standard set.

| Endpoint | What it does | Token scope | Input |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/complete` | Answers a prompt or a conversation with the app's language model. | `agent` | `system` (string), `prompt` (string), `messages` (json), `schema` (json), `maxTokens` (int), `temperature` (json), `stop` (strings), `model` (string), `thread` (string), `wait` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/stream` | Answers like Complete, sending the answer as it's written: a chunk with text for each piece, then one with done and the whole result. (stream) | `agent` | `system` (string), `prompt` (string), `messages` (json), `schema` (json), `maxTokens` (int), `temperature` (json), `stop` (strings), `model` (string), `thread` (string), `wait` (string) |
| `GET /api/_c/agent/v1` | Says which model answers the app's prompts and whether it's ready. | `agent:read` |  |
| `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/warm` | Reads the start of prompts ahead of the calls that use it (a preamble, say), so they skip reading it. | `agent` | `system` (string), `messages` (json), `prompt` (string), `wait` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/forget` | Releases a warm: its text may leave the cache like any other. | `agent` | `id` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/count` | Says how many tokens a text or a conversation is for the app's model, for budgeting what to send. | `agent:read` | `text` (string), `system` (string), `messages` (json) |
| `GET /api/_c/agent/v1/threads` | Lists the conversations whose model state the provider keeps for the app (CompleteInput.Thread). | `agent:read` |  |
| `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/threads/forget` | Drops a thread's kept state, in memory and on disk. | `agent` | `id` (string) |

## bulkmail/v1

[Contract page](/docs/contracts/bulkmail/v1). Answered by [Bulk Mail](/docs/extensions/bulkmail) in the standard set.

| Endpoint | What it does | Token scope | Input |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/_c/bulkmail/v1/count` | Says how many recipients an audience reaches, how many of them are suppressed, and a few sample addresses. | `bulkmail:read` | `audience` (json) |
| `POST /api/_c/bulkmail/v1/start` | Queues a campaign's recipients and starts sending (Limit &gt; 0: at most that many new recipients). | `bulkmail` | `campaign` (string), `limit` (int) |
| `POST /api/_c/bulkmail/v1/pause` | Stops sending a campaign; Resume carries on. | `bulkmail` | `campaign` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/bulkmail/v1/resume` | Carries on sending a paused campaign. | `bulkmail` | `campaign` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/bulkmail/v1/cancel` | Stops a campaign for good; recipients not yet sent to are dropped. | `bulkmail` | `campaign` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/bulkmail/v1/preview` | Renders a campaign's message for one recipient (the first in its audience when Email is empty). | `bulkmail:read` | `campaign` (string), `email` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/bulkmail/v1/test` | Sends a campaign's message to one address, marked as a test. | `bulkmail` | `campaign` (string), `to` (string) |

## mail.feedback/v1

[Contract page](/docs/contracts/mail.feedback/v1). Answered by [Bulk Mail](/docs/extensions/bulkmail) in the standard set.

| Endpoint | What it does | Token scope | Input |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/_c/mail.feedback/v1/ses` | Takes an Amazon SNS delivery carrying SES bounce and complaint notifications (and confirms the topic subscription). | public | raw body |
| `POST /api/_c/mail.feedback/v1/webhook` | Takes {"type": "bounce\|complaint\|unsubscribe", "email": ..., "campaign": ...} from any provider, with the shared secret in the X-Feedback-Secret header. | public | raw body |

## mail.suppression/v1

[Contract page](/docs/contracts/mail.suppression/v1). Answered by [Bulk Mail](/docs/extensions/bulkmail) in the standard set.

| Endpoint | What it does | Token scope | Input |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/_c/mail.suppression/v1/check` | Says whether an address is suppressed, and why. | `suppression:read` | `email` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/mail.suppression/v1/suppress` | Adds an address (or changes its reason). | `suppression` | `email` (string), `reason` (string), `source` (string), `campaign` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/mail.suppression/v1/unsuppress` | Removes an address, so it receives bulk mail again. | `suppression` | `email` (string) |
| `GET /api/_c/mail.suppression/v1/unsubscribe` | Is the page an unsubscribe link opens (?t=&lt;signed token&gt;). | public | `t` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/mail.suppression/v1/unsubscribe` | Confirms the page's form, or a mail provider's one-click POST (List-Unsubscribe=One-Click). | public | raw body |

## remote/v1

[Contract page](/docs/contracts/remote/v1). Answered by [Remotes](/docs/extensions/remotes) in the standard set.

| Endpoint | What it does | Token scope | Input |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/_c/remote/v1` | Says who the credential is, the app's name and URL, and the contracts it offers. | public |  |
| `GET /api/_c/remote/v1/status` | Reports whether the app is running, its versions, uptime and mode. | `remote:read` |  |
| `POST /api/_c/remote/v1/restart` | Restarts the app; requests in flight finish first. | `remote` |  |
| `GET /api/_c/remote/v1/logs` | Streams the app's log: the last entries, then new ones as they're written. (stream) | `remote:read` | `n` (int) |

## restore/v1

[Contract page](/docs/contracts/restore/v1). Answered by [PITR](/docs/extensions/pitr) in the standard set.

| Endpoint | What it does | Token scope | Input |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/_c/restore/v1` | Says what the app's data can be restored to: a window of time (continuous history) or a list of moments (backups), and whether a restore is running. | `restore:read` |  |
| `POST /api/_c/restore/v1/restore` | Puts the app's data back as it was at the given moment, from the latest point at or before it. | `restore` | `at` (time) |

## settings/v1

[Contract page](/docs/contracts/settings/v1). Answered by [Settings](/docs/extensions/settings) in the standard set.

| Endpoint | What it does | Token scope | Input |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/_c/settings/v1` | Names the extensions whose settings this app's admins can change. | `settings:read` |  |
| `GET /api/_c/settings/v1/get` | Returns one extension's settings. | `settings:read` | `extension` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/settings/v1/save` | Replaces one extension's settings and applies them. | `settings` | `extension` (string), `values` (json) |
| `POST /api/_c/settings/v1/test` | Checks one extension's settings without saving them (a test write to a bucket, a test message). | `settings` | `extension` (string), `values` (json) |
